## Example 4.1 · Annual compounding {#fm4-example-4-1-a .fm-slide }

Find the total value of an investment if \$8000 is invested at

a) 5% p.a. compounded annually for 4 years

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 10 · Example 4.1 · Complete your working in the booklet.</p>

::: notes
$r=5$ and $n=4$. $A=8000(1+5/100)^4=9724.05$, so \$9724.05. This is the final amount, not the interest. Record it for part (e).
:::
